name: voxbot
description: Voxbot is a movie-making machine controlled by voice. Let Claude hand it a job: make films, drive your apps, type for you, check your projects.
long_description:
Voxbot is a movie-making machine controlled by voice — the filmmaking app and voice assistant in your Mac's menu bar. With this extension Claude can hand Voxbot a job: check how a film project stands, look at its character, prop and location sheets, drive apps like After Effects, Premiere and Photoshop, type at the cursor, or tidy a folder.

Voxbot has to be installed and running (get it at zxrstudios.com/voxbot). Anything that costs credits — films, renders, character sheets, audio, music, images — never starts from Claude: Voxbot shows a Yes / Not yet card on your Mac and waits for your own click.
